strokeOrder: loop the isolated body and finish left without lifting

strokeOrderSource.citation: Persian Online, How to Write Persian Characters, ه demonstration at 02:47–02:50 (Liberal Arts Instructional Technology Services, Univ. of Texas at Austin)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The cited freehand lesson demonstrates isolated ه as one simple closed handwritten loop with no pen lift. The vendored Noto Naskh isolated form is wider and has two counters plus a leftward baseline finish, so this learner path preserves the source's single pen-down run while fitting that typographic outline. Contextual joins use visibly different forms.

notes: A final he can help write the vowel e.
